root_outcome: Stable multilingual voice brain dump: a real multi-minute Russian/English code-switched recording becomes individually reviewable, correctly split, language-faithful task proposals with full transcript provenance, consent that names every configured vendor, and per-proposal grounding that never poisons the batch. The US1-US3 core and the FR-016 grounding-tolerance lane are delivered; a planning-review hardening lane (consent pre-upload boundary, provider-discovery prerequisite, review-screen citations, consent-withdrawal deletion, frozen-batch partial commit, ADR-0008 rollout flag, corpus evidence report, ADR-0006 copy, title-shape invariant) remains OPEN and gates the approved handoff and the ASK-class landing.

product_decisions.question: If task creation fails partway through a reviewed batch, should already-created tasks remain and the remainder retry, or must the batch be all-or-nothing?
product_decisions.answer: Per-action durable: already-created tasks stay and a retry idempotently completes only the remaining actions (ADR-0002 per-action commit semantics, not whole-batch rollback). FR-015 and US1 acceptance scenario 4 amended. NOTE: the durable frozen-batch/per-action ledger this requires is not yet implemented - tracked as hardening task T033.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications (2026-07-29), FR-015, US1 scenario 4; ADR-0002 sections 485-519; tasks.md T033

product_decisions.question: Is a correctly transcribed proper noun mandatory, or is dropping a task with a garbled proper noun acceptable until follow-up tolerance?
product_decisions.answer: Fail-closed omission accepted. FR-001 narrowed: proper-noun preservation is best-effort; heavily garbled nouns are not guessed and dependent proposals fail closed (FR-016 tolerance recovers close mishears). Edge Cases and success criteria aligned.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications (2026-07-29), FR-001, FR-016, proper-noun Edge Case

product_decisions.question: What is the canonical title-fidelity rule for generated task proposals (given code-switched utterances and multi-language evidence)?
product_decisions.answer: Language-faithful rewrites: titles preserve the source language, intent, proper nouns, and embedded foreign terms; grammatical inflection and grounded rewording are allowed (not necessarily a verbatim subsequence); omission of non-core details for conciseness is allowed; translation is prohibited. The extractive-subsequence option was declined (it would contradict delivered FR-008 morphology tolerance). FR-006/FR-007/FR-008 rewritten to separate title-generation from grounding tolerance; a title-shape invariant is tracked as hardening task T037.
product_decisions.evidence_ref: spec.md Clarifications (2026-07-29), FR-006, FR-007, FR-008, US1 scenario 1, SC-003; tasks.md T037

risks: Handoff is NOT approved: the rerun0729 high-risk campaign returned ~11 blocking technical findings across all four reviewers (status reads product-decision-required only because the one product decision outranks blocking findings in aggregation). Most require code/test changes (the hardening lane); a campaign rerun cannot reach approved until they land.

Real-provider dependence (Deepgram nova-3, OpenAI gpt-4o): outage, quota, or contract drift degrades capture; mitigated by terminal-vs-retryable classification, bounded retries, checkpoint resume, and deterministic CI providers.

Privacy egress: until T029/T030 land, a degraded provider-discovery path can egress audio under consent that displayed no vendor name (OpenAI-only deployment), and consent withdrawal does not yet schedule deletion of uncommitted transcripts (T032).
Commit durability: FR-015 per-action durable semantics are specified but not yet backed by a frozen batch / per-action ledger (T033); a mid-batch failure is currently untested.
ADR-0002 release targets (>=95% task-count accuracy/boundary, 100% critical-term) are not met by this below-gate experimental dogfood slice (~82%); documented, not a delivered ADR-0002 acceptance.
Reference-corpus overfitting: metrics come from one founder-read 50-utterance corpus; broader capture may shift boundary precision and translation rates.
